ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; predominantly low-intensity pixels (>90% black/dark grey) with sparse high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and scattered across the surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white clusters located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; scattered white focal points (stippling) distributed across the central dark field; overall monochromatic dark pigmentation.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; specific deep notches visible on the medial portion of the right lobe; significant jaggedness on the lateral margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the outer distal edges transitioning to a concave curve approaching the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups (barnacle colonization) at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; several isolated circular white scars on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) cutting through the dark pigment on the left lobe mid-section and right lobe upper-quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily serrated and irregular trailing edge suggesting historical tissue loss; prominent calcified barnacle clusters at the tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique protrusion of high-intensity white clusters (barnacles) on the far right lateral tip creating a distinct irregular silhouette.
